output.summary: The user requires a >= 20% decrease in safety incidents per 10,000 service miles. Last year's rate was 38 incidents / 120k miles = 3.17 per 10k. This year's rate is 28 incidents / 78k miles = 3.59 per 10k. The rate actually increased by approximately 13%, violating the constraint. The headline 26% drop refers to total incident count, not the normalized rate, which failed to improve due to the significant drop in mileage.
key_claims: Last year's incident rate: 3.17 per 10,000 miles
This year's incident rate: 3.59 per 10,000 miles
The rate increased by ~13%, failing the >= 20% decrease requirement
risks_or_flaws: The safety incident rate per 10,000 miles increased rather than decreased, violating the explicit constraint for authorization.
